review.notes: Conflicting evidence preserved: the pinned modern cdb text matches NO lineage version (best ratio 0.282 against v2). The English errata lineage ends at v2 (DB2-EN241, Dark Beginning 2, 2005-07-27) and the card appears never to have been reprinted in English since, so the current PSCT text exists only in the card database - hence set-release evidence is unavailable and effective is left empty rather than dated from memory. Chronology note, not flagged as an era mismatch: the GOAT variant implements v2, whose printing (2005-07-27) postdates the 2005-04-01 GOAT snapshot, but the only v1 -> v2 difference is the added 'and the effect' after 'Negate the activation', which is a clarification of what negating an activation already does, so the baseline is behaviourally correct for the GOAT snapshot's v1 (TP5-EN018, 2004-11-01) text. v0 -> v1 is the Magic -> Spell renaming.

event.historical_text: Negate the activation and the effect of a Spell or Trap Card that includes the effect of destroying 1 Spell or Trap Card and destroy it.
event.summary: Behavioural difference: the modern script will only negate a chained card whose activation effect carries EFFECT_FLAG_CARD_TARGET and whose chain info holds exactly one target card, whereas goat/c504700133.lua drops both tests and inspects only the chain's CATEGORY_DESTROY operation info, so it can also negate non-targeting Spell/Trap destruction (the upstream annotation reads 'does not require targeting'). The modern BabelCDB text states the requirement explicitly - 'that targets 1 Spell/Trap on the field (and no other cards)' - but no English lineage version carries that text, so the change has no set-release anchor and its chronology is left unresolved.
